naomi_cs: Flagging a brief EU onboarding disruption 2026-03-25 11:00-11:35 UTC affecting three trial tenants (T-5201, T-5208, T-5212). Some onboarding calls returned 502s or saw long tail latency. Preparing outbound comms and remediation offers.

dex_support: Observed retry amplification around 11:03. We routed traffic to the standby pool at 11:10 and primed tenant caches; error rate dropped ~65% but a few requests retried repeatedly.

carlos_eng: Root cause: bursty webhook payloads exposed a scheduling edge-case in our ingest worker; workers were spinning and hitting ephemeral resource limits. Temporary mitigation: lowered batch window and capped concurrency to 4 at 11:12. Full fix in review, ETA ~4h.

naomi_cs: Draft outgoing note below  short, empathetic, and offer hands-on help. Please review.

naomi_cs: ```Hi <Name>,

Were sorry  you may have experienced delays during onboarding on Mar 25 between 11:0011:35 UTC in our EU environment. Some API calls returned intermittent errors (502) and retries caused longer completion times.

What we did: routed traffic to a standby pool, primed caches for active tenants, and applied a temporary concurrency cap while we build a permanent fix.

Offer: we can re-run stalled onboarding jobs for you, schedule a 30-minute session with an integration engineer to walk through any failed steps, and apply a one-time billing credit for retry-related usage.

If cross-region failover is acceptable, we can temporarily route your traffic to the global pool to speed completion  otherwise we will coordinate a non-cross-region remediation.

We will follow up with an RCA within 48 hours. Reply if youd like a re-run or to book the session.

Best,
Naomi (Customer Success)
```

dex_support: Recommend adding quick self-help: reduce batch_size to 4 and add retry_backoff 250ms. Also include link to internal runbook for replays.

mia_billing: Approved credit wording: "A one-time credit equivalent to estimated retry compute during the impacted window will be applied to your next invoice." Legal cleared.

incident_bot: Incident created: P2 - EU Onboard Burst. Lead: carlos_eng.

naomi_cs: Thanks team. I'll localize and send now, tag renewals for high-touch follow-up on T-5208. Will paste sent copy and recipients here after send. :pray:
